title: FreeEval: A Modular Framework for Trustworthy and Efficient Evaluation of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Providing bias evaluation modules and visualization tools specifically for LLM-based evaluators to detect if they unfairly prefer candidate responses based on their order or placement.
Providing bias evaluation modules and visualization tools specifically for LLM-based evaluators to detect if they disproportionately favor longer text responses over shorter ones.
